description: This file contains utility functions to parse different types of requests, form JSON responses for various operations, map status codes to messages, and handle internal data structures related to a C-based device management or configuration framework. It includes functions for parsing get/set requests, forming responses, and status message mapping, notably for a testing or stub implementation.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON get request, extracts parameters based on payload type, handles attributes, and populates a request structure.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON set request, extracting parameters, values, and types, populating a request structure accordingly.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for setting attributes, especially notification attributes, and populates the request structure.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a test and set JSON request, extracting CID values, synchronization parameters, and parameters list.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a replace rows request for table data, extracting row data and object name.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to add a row to a table, extracting row data and object name.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to delete a specific row from a table, based on a row identifier.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Constructs a JSON response for a get request, including parameter values and handling multiple parameter counts.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Constructs a JSON response for get attribute requests, including notification attributes.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a set operation, with status messages for each parameter.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for table row replacement operations, including success status.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Prepares a JSON response for test-and-set operations, including synchronization parameters.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable status messages.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines overall response status code based on individual parameter status results.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
